articles.headline: Zee Entertainment reports 18% jump in operating profit for Q2 FY27
articles.summary: Broadcasting giant Zee Entertainment Enterprises posted robust earnings driven by high advertisement recovery across Hindi and regional general entertainment channels.

articles.headline: Indian advertising industry projected to hit Rs 1.35 lakh crore by end of 2026
articles.summary: Digital advertising continues to outpace traditional media, claiming a 58% share of total marketing expenditure according to GroupM's revised annual forecast.

articles.headline: Tata Consumer Products expands premium packaged food portfolio with new sub-brand
articles.summary: Targeted at health-conscious urban shoppers, the new product line will be backed by a 360-degree campaign across digital, influencer, and modern trade channels.

articles.headline: BARC India introduces updated CTV household measurement metrics across top metros
articles.summary: Broadcast audience measurement council expands sample size to provide granular co-viewing insights for advertisers spending on connected television.

articles.headline: Meta India rolls out new AI creative suite for direct-to-consumer businesses
articles.summary: The generative AI toolkit allows performance advertisers to automatically generate catalog variants, localized voiceovers, and dynamic aspect ratios.

articles.headline: Sony Pictures Networks signs multi-year digital streaming rights for European football
articles.summary: The network will broadcast top-flight club competitions live across Sony LIV and linear sports networks with multi-language feeds.

articles.headline: Festive brand warfare: E-commerce platforms book prime ad spots on reality shows
articles.summary: Amazon, Flipkart, and Meesho lock in title sponsorships across Bigg Boss and Kaun Banega Crorepati to drive festive shopping traffic.

articles.headline: Marico strengthens wellness portfolio with majority stake acquisition in ayurvedic startup
articles.summary: The strategic deal accelerates Marico's direct-to-consumer healthcare footprint across premium natural care categories.

articles.headline: TRAI issues consultation paper on broadcast tariffs and channel bundling rules
articles.summary: Telecom regulator invites stakeholder feedback on NTO regulations to enhance transparency and consumer choice in pay-TV packages.

articles.headline: Havas Media India bags comprehensive integrated media mandate for Swiggy
articles.summary: Following a competitive multi-agency pitch, Havas will oversee offline media planning and high-impact sports properties for the food and grocery platform.
